claim_boundary: Not a finished curriculum, CEFR certification, TORFL preparation promise, or proficiency score.

evidence_ladder.label: Encountered
evidence_ladder.observation_contract: The learner saw or heard the target in context.
evidence_ladder.promotion_boundary: Never changes ability state by itself.

evidence_ladder.label: Recognized
evidence_ladder.observation_contract: The learner distinguished meaning/form across more than one item family with declared support.
evidence_ladder.promotion_boundary: Promotion rule must be calibrated; no one-item pass.
evidence_ladder.traceability: Attempt family, support and content version are logged.

evidence_ladder.label: Produced with support
evidence_ladder.observation_contract: The learner spoke or wrote the function with a declared scaffold or fallback.
evidence_ladder.promotion_boundary: Speech uncertainty stays visible; typed output is labeled separately.
evidence_ladder.traceability: Mode, support tier and evaluator are logged.

evidence_ladder.label: Transferred
evidence_ladder.observation_contract: The learner handled a changed detail without answer reveal in a new scene.
evidence_ladder.promotion_boundary: Required before a functional can-do is shown.
evidence_ladder.traceability: Changed variable and repair use are logged.

evidence_ladder.label: Returned
evidence_ladder.observation_contract: The learner repeated the function after a delay with new surface details.
evidence_ladder.promotion_boundary: Required before stable language; decay rules await calibration.
evidence_ladder.traceability: Elapsed time, variants and prior support are logged.
